# First local reading-state producer

`payload` contains the exact eleven files retained from the first real version-1
producer in fleet job `11b295ca98313678a508bf417a35d2e9`. The manifest records its
source, snapshot, generating test, file sizes and SHA-256 values. The producing
source passed all 2,070 Python tests together; consumption of this frozen set is
qualified separately in the next selected gate.

The generating Qt journey saved actual position, bookmark and preferences for a
two-page synthetic CBZ and one-chapter synthetic EPUB. Publication provenance and
inventory accompany both archives so the set can exercise working-library
adoption. It contains no owner's comics, account session or registry keys.
The outer directory was named `Library` by the producer; `payload` avoids the
repository-wide exclusion of personal `Library` folders. File bytes are unchanged.

Keep this set immutable. Add later producer sets beside it. The frozen consumer
checks every stored field, actual archive rendering, adoption, relocation and
unchanged sources. This is the first development producer, not evidence of an
earlier public release or Android reading UI.
